behavior_class_name: Backdoor Persistence Service Foothold Behavior Class
description: Creates persistence by registering a permanent WMI event subscription in the root\subscription namespace. The installer creates a registry test key, registers an __EventFilter that monitors a registry value change, creates a CommandLineEventConsumer that launches a benign marker payload, and binds the filter to the consumer through __FilterToConsumerBinding.

persistence_installer.role: connects to root\subscription, creates the registry trigger key, registers a permanent WMI __EventFilter, creates a CommandLineEventConsumer, binds the filter to the consumer, fires a validation registry trigger, and supports cleanup of created artifacts

marker_payload.role: benign executable launched by the WMI CommandLineEventConsumer to write marker telemetry confirming WMI-triggered execution

persistence_behavior.wql_query: SELECT * FROM RegistryValueChangeEvent WHERE Hive='HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE' AND KeyPath='SOFTWARE\\A06_4_Test' AND ValueName='Trigger'

registry: registry value modification triggers WMI event delivery
process: marker payload executes after registry trigger fires
file_system: marker file contains timestamp, PID, and process path telemetry
host: permanent WMI __EventFilter is created in root\subscription
permanent WMI CommandLineEventConsumer is created in root\subscription
WMI-Activity Operational logs may record event consumer activity
Sysmon Event ID 1 may capture marker payload execution
Sysmon Event ID 11 may capture marker file creation
network: no HTTP or HTTPS traffic is required
no TCP command channel is opened

code_placement: Permanent WMI event subscription creation and cleanup logic are implemented in the C# installer. Execution confirmation is implemented in the C++ marker payload through marker-file telemetry and OutputDebugStringA.
execution_trigger: The installer executes manually. The persistence payload executes automatically when the monitored registry value HKLM\SOFTWARE\A06_4_Test\Trigger changes and satisfies the WMI RegistryValueChangeEvent query.
execution_target: WMI permanent event subscription subsystem and marker executable at C:\Users\Public\A06_4_marker.exe
semantic_meaning: Demonstrates event-driven persistence using a permanent WMI event subscription, where an event filter monitors a registry value change and a bound command-line consumer launches a payload without relying on traditional startup folders, Run keys, services, or scheduled tasks.

mitre_attack_mapping.note: Permanent WMI event subscription persistence using __EventFilter, CommandLineEventConsumer, and __FilterToConsumerBinding.

control_notes.payload_effect: writes marker-file telemetry confirming WMI-triggered execution

success_conditions: Trigger registry value is initialized to INITIAL
__FilterToConsumerBinding is created between the filter and consumer
registry value HKLM\SOFTWARE\A06_4_Test\Trigger is modified to A06_4_FIRE
marker file contains timestamp, PID, and process path
no network activity or secondary payload execution occurs
cleanup mode removes the WMI binding, filter, consumer, and test registry key
